subject: English
passage: The Canterbury Tales is a medieval collection of stories written by Geoffrey Chaucer in the late 14th century. Based on the experiences of pilgrims traveling to Canterbury Cathedral during the reign of Richard II, ______ had once been a trusted advisor to the king but was later exiled for challenging royal authority.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: the Wife of Bath, the character in The Canterbury Tales,
choices.B: the character whose story is told in The Canterbury Tales, the Wife of Bath,
choices.C: there was a character, the Wife of Bath, who in The Canterbury Tales
choices.D: The Canterbury Tales tells the story of the Wife of Bath, a character who

explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The modifier "Based on the experiences...Richard II," is describing the work "The Canterbury Tales." Modifiers need to be next to the subjects they describe, so "The Canterbury Tales" needs to be the first word after the comma.
